statement: A combined Spin2 + PASM2 example listing uses, in its DAT code, registers whose names are locals of the same listing's `PUB main()`, and declares them nowhere in the DAT: smart-pin-01011-quadrature-encoder.yaml:67 (`rdpin position, #enc_a`; `position` is a local of main), smart-pin-01100-count-a-rise-b-high.yaml:62 (`rdpin count, #sig_pin`; `count`), smart-pin-10000-time-a-states.yaml:70 (`rdpin duration, #pwm_pin wc`; `duration`, `high_time`, `low_time`), smart-pin-10001-time-a-highs.yaml:65 (`rdpin pulse_width, #pulse_pin`; `pulse_width`; the block also never declares `pulse_count`), smart-pin-11110-async-serial-transmit.yaml:73 (`mov bit_period, ##(_clkfreq / baud) << 16`; second error behind the S-074 alignment error), smart-pin-11111-async-serial-receive.yaml:71 (`mov bit_period, ...`). The DAT sees no method locals, so each use is an undefined symbol; declaring the register in the DAT does not help, because a DAT symbol with a method local's name is refused at the local's declaration (m242 'Expected a unique variable name'). The listing can only be repaired by renaming one side. (Sibling of S-045, inline PASM register vs parameter.)
